error: Cannot set NUMBA_NUM_THREADS to a different value once the threads have been launched (currently have 1, trying to set 48)
cause: The default ActivitySim CLI reset NUMBA_NUM_THREADS after the Numba pool had initialized.
resolution: Use the upstream --fast CLI option to preserve pool capacity; explicitly retain one thread in other numerical libraries; mask Numba to one except during the selected frequency step. The final matched control uses the same initial pool and mask.
